dedupe_keys.name: enacom argentina telecom market indicators open data fixed internet accesses by province locality technology and speed mobile fixed telephony and pay tv

description: Argentina's national communications regulator publishes its main market indicators as open data, harvested to the national portal datos.gob.ar. The fixed internet dataset has 14 tables, each as CSV and XLSX: broadband accesses by province and in total; accesses by technology (such as ADSL, cable modem, fibre, wireless and satellite) by locality, by province and in total; accesses by contracted speed by locality and province and by speed band; revenues; penetration per 100 households and per 100 inhabitants by province; and average download speed by province. The mobile communications dataset gives accesses, revenues, calls, minutes, penetration and SMS. Matching datasets cover fixed telephony, pay TV, number portability and the postal market. All were refreshed in June 2026, with quarterly series. Coverage: Argentina, by province and, for fixed internet, by locality. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files on the regulator's indicator site, listed on datos.gob.ar, free; the portal lists no licence for these datasets. Caveats: operator-reported accesses, not coverage; locality tables give counts, not maps; the regulator's servers failed TLS verification from the collection environment, so file contents and series start were not checked. Simulation uses: provincial and local fixed broadband demand by technology and speed for Argentine service models, and mobile traffic trends. Related records: the LAC-IX survey and map covers Argentine exchange points; the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series.
